brand.name: LinknRun
brand.tagline: Running is better with someone next to you

hero.headline: Find your run. Find your people.
hero.subhead: LinknRun matches you with runners nearby, tracks every session, and keeps your streak alive. Running alone is optional now.

valueProps.label: Partners
valueProps.headline: Run with someone
valueProps.body: Match with joggers near you and turn a solo lap into a shared one.

valueProps.label: Streaks
valueProps.headline: Keep the fire burning
valueProps.body: Log a session each day and watch your streak grow, one run at a time.

valueProps.label: Sessions
valueProps.headline: Every run, tracked
valueProps.body: Distance, pace, calories. See exactly what each run cost and gave back.

valueProps.label: Social
valueProps.headline: Talk after you run
valueProps.body: Chat with your running circle straight from the app.

network.headline: Built to connect, not just track
network.body: The map, the chat, and your friend list all work together so a run turns into a running circle.

features.headline: See who's nearby
features.body: Open the map and spot runners near you in real time. Send a link-up request and meet at the start line.

features.headline: Talk before, during, after
features.body: Every running circle gets its own chat. Plan a route, share a pace, or just talk trash before the next run.

features.headline: Build your circle
features.body: Add runners you meet as friends. Your circle grows with every route, and shows up first on the map.

showcase.headline: Built for the road, not the boardroom
showcase.body: A quick look at what waits on your phone once you're in.

download.headline: LinknRun is almost here
download.body: The Android build lands on Google Play soon. A direct download will follow.

highlights.label: Every run logged
highlights.body: Distance, pace, and calories saved automatically.

highlights.label: Partners nearby
highlights.body: See runners close to you and send a link-up request.

highlights.label: Stay in touch
highlights.body: Chat with your circle before and after every run.

highlights.label: Streaks that stick
highlights.body: One session a day keeps the fire burning.

team.headline: Meet the team
team.body: Three people building LinknRun, one commit and one run at a time.
